scope: Human-reviewed offline material study; no runtime acceptance
findings: The two original bright neutral palette roles remain distinguishable in clear/overcast light; membrane is lighter and mineral slightly warm-grey/green.
Both 2m and 10m coupon overviews retain the same two-metre physical repeat; the 1m ruler and 1.75m/1.81m study figures are visible and never exported.
Mineral grain and membrane lap normals are deliberately subtle in overview; grazing-angle actual reimport renders expose their distinct relief.
No baked lighting exists in base color: the actual exporter uses EMIT for pigment and ORM, NORMAL for tangents. Preview shadowing is scene lighting only.
Dusk and night darken both surfaces at fixed exposure. Night is intentionally very dim and is not evidence of city visibility.
knownLimitations: At the 0.68m close-up view, 256px over a 2m tile shows expected bilinear softness, especially on thin membrane laps. Source 512px bakes preserve more detail but are not runtime candidates.
Two-triangle flat coupons have no true displacement, gravel silhouettes, edge flashing, roof thickness, drainage or collision.
Low 12-sample overview renders contain Monte Carlo noise; detail renders use 32 samples.
Full 2m periodic repetition can become visible on larger roofs. WebGL filtering, far-distance fade, source-local phase and color normalization require scene testing.
The membrane longitudinal lap is 1m spaced within a 2m x 2m tile; end laps repeat at 2m. This is a representative study, not a surveyed product installation.
conditionClaim: Offline clear/overcast/dusk/night study lighting, not matching city weather.
